decisions.statement: The points before today are the sum over the counted days short of today.
Today itself is left out of the points before today.
Each attribute's figure is kept beside that attribute's own page.
The readings are taken again once the figures are kept.
An attribute that could not be read keeps the figure it already had.
A run that rebuilt no attribute at all is refused.
Each attribute is named as soon as that attribute's figure is kept.
A run that threw part way names those attributes in its refusal.
The keeping and the taking this runs are handed in.
A run works out no level.
A call saying any word is refused, because this takes no argument.

definition: the command working out again what each attribute earned before today
